review.notes: Full review. All 15 sampled targets and every Lean statement recomputed on degenerate cases (table in the report); Crofton constants checked on the ball for all j <= k <= d <= 6. None of the four cited books is legally readable (three paywalled, one refused), so no locator was verified against a text and wording/arrangement were not compared: listed under Not verifiable and for the human reviewers. Library declarations opened at Mathlib 1b1ccf4 and Tau Ceti 2fd255d; 5 of 5 cross-roadmap citations resolved; dependency check 0 problems; Suggested.lean elaborates with 44 sorry warnings only. One automatic check (section comment over the #check pins) set aside as a false positive. Findings: Cauchy formula constant (P1), two false Checks (P2), mean width owned twice with MeanWidthAndCauchyFormulas (P2).
